description: Send Audora feedback it will read, as one of these kinds. missing_capability: a change you would need to do what the artist wants. connector_improvement: how this connector could work better for an assistant, such as a confusing tool, a missing field or a result that did not tell you enough. product_improvement: how Audora itself could serve artists better. bug: something that looks broken. other: anything else. It goes into Audora's support inbox and shows in the artist's Settings › Support, so write it for a person: what you were trying to do, what got in the way and what would have helped. Use it when you notice something worth fixing. You do not need the artist's permission, but set artist_asked to true when the artist asked for it. For a plain "there is no tool for that", report_gap is enough.

artist_asked.description: True when the artist asked for this or said it; false or omitted when it is your own observation.

details.description: What you or the artist were trying to do, what got in the way and the change that would have helped. Up to 5000 characters. No passwords, tokens or other secrets.

summary.description: One line someone at Audora can triage from. Up to 120 characters.

tool.description: The tool this is about, if it is about one.

name: send_feedback
title: Tell Audora how it could serve the artist better
